name: systems
definition_zh: 通过轮轨相互作用联系起来的车辆与轨道系统。
usage_note: 保留 coupled；仅出现 vehicle–track system 时应检查上下文。vehicle 不自动替换为 train，车辆与列车应分别表达。
usage_overview: 用于将车辆、轨道及轮轨界面共同作为随机动力分析的整体对象，通过轮轨相互作用描述车辆与轨道之间的联系，并分析系统的随机动力响应。

complete_examples.text: It is difficult to grasp the features of stochastic systems using dynamic trajectories.
The efforts devoted to capturing the response information on the PDFs of vehicle–track temporal–spatial stochastic systems are studied in this paper.

Stochastic Model Used for Temporal-spatial Analysis of Vehicle-track Coupled Systems XU Lei, ZHAI Wanming (State Key Laboratory of Traction Power, Southwest Jiaotong University, Chengdu 610031, China) Abstracts: Vehicle-track coupled system has the random nature in time-space domain.

Finally, an analysis was carried out on the temporal-spatial stochastic vibrations of vehicle-track systems subjected to different coefficients of variation, in which the dynamic parameters were assumed to be subject to normal distribution, and the time-space stochastic simulation of track irregularities was conducted based on measured data.
